Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by kbar (https://kbar.vercel.app/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, javascript, radix-ui.
Component specification: 最后开 Overview。功能列表和 API 侧栏在此。
Key visual & interaction patterns: 命令面板.
Visual details from source observation: kbar.vercel.app 定义为站点的 command+k 界面，并提示按快捷键打开。入门页写 npm install kbar 与 KBarProvider。Overview 列出键盘导航、撤销与屏幕阅读器。MIT。本条不是 cmdk。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
